rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.dialogue: The old paths need kind footsteps.

smith.name: Bram
smith.dialogue:
A good blade should feel like an old friend. My ironwood blades are ready for the road.

Choose Trade to buy a blade or a leather vest.

merchant.name: Mira
merchant.dialogue:
Tonics, dry socks, and stories from the next valley. That's what a traveler needs.

Choose Trade to buy a tonic or sell spare materials.

keeper.name: Elowen
keeper.dialogue:
The wishing stone restores your health. Offer an Astral Shard to receive a relic. You can find shards in caches, from enemies, and through quests.

Each wish costs 1 shard. Wear a relic in your satchel to awaken its gift.

fernwatch_ranger.name: Aster
fernwatch_ranger.dialogue: Our paths follow living roots. Earn the Wardens’ trust and I will teach you the elderwood bow.

fernwatch_alchemist.name: Nessa
fernwatch_alchemist.dialogue: Silverleaf grows along the banks. Rain brings a little extra harvest.

ironvein_smith.name: Orrin
ironvein_smith.dialogue: The old mine has gone silent. Its work ledger is sealed behind a guardian’s oath.

crossroads_trader.name: Tamsin
crossroads_trader.dialogue: Every road meets another. My stall keeps the caravans supplied.

traveling.name: Peregrin
traveling.dialogue: Only here until dusk. A small pack means a few unusual bargains.
